name: Eat Snakes Simulator
desc:
🔴 Welcome to Eat Snakes Simulator! 🔴 

Winter Update!
🎄 USE CODES:  SNOWFLAKE, SANTA, PRESENTS
🎁 MORE PRESENTS TO COLLECT!

How to Play: 
🏃‍ Collect food on the Ground 🏃‍ 
⚔️ Defeat players smaller than you ⚔️ 
💀 Collect Skulls to unlock Rare Skins 💀 
🏆 Become the Strongest in the game 🏆

Collect orbs and defeat weaker players to become the best blob in this awesome collecting simulator! 
Important: All purchases except for skulls are not permanent and last for 1 life.

scripts.title: GET EVERYTHING FOR FREE
scripts.script:
local run = true

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.01) do
        if run then
            pcall(function()
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                    .Packages._Index["sleitnick_knit@1.5.1"]
                    .knit.Services.GiftService.RF.GetPresent:InvokeServer("Present")
            end)
            pcall(function()
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                    .Packages._Index["sleitnick_knit@1.5.1"]
                    .knit.Services.GiftService.RF.GetPresent:InvokeServer("SuperPresent")
            end)
        end
    end
end)

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if not gpe and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then
        run = not run
        print("Toggled:", run)
    end
end)
